capabilities: Generate inline autocompletions as you type
Accept suggestions with Tab or custom hotkeys
Customize system and user prompts with template variables
Assign per-path profiles with different prompts
Connect to Ollama, Gemini, Grok, OpenAI, or OpenAI-compatible providers
extras: README recommends Ollama (with a model of at least 8B params, e.g. gemma3:12b) or Gemini's free tier to reduce API costs from frequent calls; suggests more providers may be added via PR.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in inline AI text completion while writing; suggestions require manually invoking commands or switching to a chat interface.

requires.name: Gemini, Grok, OpenAI, or OpenAI-compatible API key

summary: AI-powered inline autocompletion plugin that suggests text as you type, accepted or rejected with Tab.
